description.value: Banana Leaf Surrey is the South Surrey outpost of a well-established Malaysian restaurant group with five Lower Mainland locations. The kitchen prepares family-style dishes with freshly made in-house sauces and offers multi-course tasting menus alongside an à la carte menu spanning satay, laksa, seafood curries, and roti canai. Takeout and third-party delivery round out the options for cyclists who want a flavourful meal on the go.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active, operating Malaysian restaurant at 450-3099 152 St., South Surrey, with matching phone (604-385-1885) and matching unit/address details from OSM. The site's navigation includes 'ORDER PICKUP' and a dedicated 'TAKEOUT MENU' confirming takeout service; multiple menu items carry GF labels and vegetarian/vegan markers (🌿) with a note that 'all dishes can be made... without meat or seafood.' No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or any other cycling-specific infrastructure appears anywhere in the website content.
concerns: OSM name uses 'Surrey' but website and location listing consistently label this branch 'South Surrey' — minor discrepancy, not material to listing.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, actively operating sit-down restaurant with confirmed address, phone, and website. Full menus and hours published; clearly open to the public.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu items marked 🌿 (vegetarian) include spring rolls, eggplant fries, and tofu goreng; multiple dishes labelled 'GF'; menu notes 'all dishes can be made... without meat or seafood.'

wow_evidence: well-established Malaysian restaurant group with five Lower Mainland locations

price.label: Upscale
price.signal: A la carte mains $25-40; tasting menus $40-65/person signal upscale
